FAQ

Good to know

How do I place an order?

Add items to your cart and send the order on WhatsApp, or message the manager directly on 0757 456 928.

Do you deliver outside Nakuru?

Yes. We deliver within Nakuru and countrywide. The manager confirms the delivery cost for your location.

How do I get the price of an item?

Items showing “Ask for price” are quoted by the manager on WhatsApp, so you always get today’s price.

Are the phones and laptops refurbished?

We stock refurbished phones and laptops as well as new Redmi phones. Ask the manager about condition and warranty for each item.

Do you offer soft loans?

Yes. Send an inquiry on WhatsApp (0757 456 928) or call 0112 363 463 and our team will explain how it works.

Can I visit the shop?

Yes. We are in Njoro, around Egerton University, open every day from 8AM to 10PM.

Our shop

Everything for a happy home

Joytech Solutions is based in Njoro, around Egerton University. We supply electronics, appliances, furniture and interior products to students, families and businesses in Nakuru and across Kenya.

From TVs, phones and laptops to beds, mattresses, couches and cooking gas, you can browse online, chat with the manager on WhatsApp and have your order delivered. We also offer soft loans, so ask the manager how it works.

Privacy Policy

We collect only what is needed to process your order: your name, phone number, delivery location and the items you choose. Orders are sent to our manager through WhatsApp, so WhatsApp’s own privacy terms also apply.

  • We use your details to confirm, deliver and support your order.
  • We never sell your personal information.
  • We share details with delivery partners only as needed to reach you.
  • To correct or delete your details, call or message 0757 456 928.

Cookies Policy

This website uses only essential browser storage: to remember your cookie choice, your cart, saved items and reviews you submit. We use no advertising or tracking cookies. You can clear this storage anytime in your browser settings.

Delivery & ordering

Place an order on the website or via WhatsApp. The manager confirms availability, price and delivery cost before you pay. Delivery is available within Nakuru and countrywide.

Ready to order?

Chat with the manager on WhatsApp or call us. Open daily 8AM–10PM, delivery countrywide.
